items.title: Billy McBride and Mary McBride ("Mack and Mack") Interview, 1959-07-01
items.q: He played trombone for us a while, Peter Bocard.

ctx.x: And then they had a man in New Orleans that was an all around man, played all instruments. He played trombone for us a while, Peter Bocard.
Oh yes, he's still active, he still plays trombone.
